# Perspective Audit

## Step 1 — Confirm escalated perspectives

The a11y-critic output flags two perspectives for deep review:

- **Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity**: HIGH
- **Cognitive & Neurodivergent**: MEDIUM

All other perspectives are at LOW and will not be reviewed.

---

## Step 2 — Read reference files

I have read the following sections from `references/perspectives.md`:
- Section 3: Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity (full checklist + red flags)
- Section 7: Cognitive & Neurodivergent (full checklist + red flags)

And I've reviewed the full ARRM mapping in `arrm-perspective-mapping.md`.

---

## Step 3 — Read artifact under review

The component is a React-based product carousel with autoplay animation. Key observations from source code and CSS:

- Autoplay via `setInterval` every 3 seconds (`useEffect`)
- Slide transition uses CSS `transform` + `transition`
- Badge has infinite pulsing `@keyframes` animation
- `data-parallax="true"` attribute on wrapper (though no parallax logic implemented in JS)
- No pause/stop control for autoplay
- No `prefers-reduced-motion` media query anywhere
- Manual navigation via prev/next buttons only — no play/pause toggle

---

## Step 4 — Run per-perspective checklists

### Perspective 3: Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity (HIGH)

#### Checklist Review:

1. ✅ **All non-essential animations suppressed when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active**
   - ❌ FAIL — No `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block exists in CSS or JS logic to disable transitions/animations.

2. ✅ **Essential animations reduced to opacity/fade only under reduced-motion**
   - N/A — Not applicable since no reduced-motion handling exists at all.

3. ❌ **Auto-playing content >5 seconds has visible pause/stop/hide control (2.2.2)**
   - FAIL — Carousel auto-advances every 3 seconds indefinitely with NO pause, stop, or hide mechanism exposed to the user.

4. ✅ **No content flashes more than 3 times per second (2.3.1)**
   - PASS — Badge pulse animation runs at ~0.8s cycle; slide transitions are smooth fades/slides well under flash threshold.

5. N/A **Device motion functionality with UI alternative**
   - Not applicable — No device-motion-triggered features present.

6. ❌ **Parallax scrolling removed or disabled under reduced-motion**
   - FAIL — `data-parallax="true"` is set on wrapper, suggesting intent for parallax effect (even if not currently active). Should be guarded by reduced-motion query.

7. ✅ **Video auto-play disabled or controlled by user**
   - N/A — No video elements present.

#### Red Flags Check:

- ❌ `prefers-reduced-motion` media query absent when animations exist → Auto-CRITICAL
- ❌ No pause control on auto-playing carousel → Auto-CRITICAL

Both red flags fire, making this perspective **CRITICAL**.

---

### Perspective 7: Cognitive & Neurodivergent (MEDIUM)

#### Checklist Review:

1. ✅ **Error messages suggest specific corrective action**
   - N/A — No form inputs or error states in component.

2. ✅ **Multi-step forms do not re-ask information provided earlier**
   - N/A — Not a multi-step form.

3. ✅ **Authentication does not require transcription/memorization/puzzle-solving; paste works**
   - N/A — No authentication involved.

4. ❌ **Navigation appears in same relative position across all pages (3.2.3)**
   - FAIL — Carousel auto-advances every 3 seconds, causing unexpected content changes that disrupt cognitive predictability and reading flow.

5. ✅ **Components with same function have consistent labels/icons**
   - PASS — Prev/next buttons consistently labeled throughout lifecycle.

6. N/A **Help mechanism in same location on every page (3.2.6)**
   - Not applicable to this isolated component.

7. ❌ **Focus on element does not auto-trigger context change (3.2.1)**
   - FAIL — Auto-advance timer triggers slide changes regardless of whether user is interacting with controls, violating expectation that focus shouldn’t cause unexpected shifts.

8. ✅ **Changing form control value doesn't auto-submit/navigate**
   - N/A — No form controls present.

9. ✅ **Destructive actions have undo/confirmation/review step (3.3.4)**
   - PASS — Navigation is non-destructive; no irreversible operations occur.

10. ✅ **More than one way to reach any page (2.4.5)**
    - N/A — Component-level review only.

11. N/A **Input fields for personal data have autocomplete attributes**
    - Not applicable.

12. ❌ **Timeout warnings give ≥ 20 seconds to extend (2.2.1)**
    - FAIL — Auto-advance occurs every 3 seconds with no warning or opportunity to pause/extend interaction time.

13. ✅ **Content avoids unexplained jargon, undefined abbreviations, complex sentences**
    - PASS — Product names and prices are simple and clear.

#### Neurodivergent-Specific Checks:

- ❌ **Page layout is predictable – main content in expected location, no layout shifts**
  - FAIL — Continuous auto-sliding creates unpredictable visual movement disrupting attention/focus.

- ✅ **Visual hierarchy is clear**
  - PASS — Headings, spacing, and grouping are logically structured.

- ❌ **No autoplay media or unprompted modal dialogs**
  - FAIL — Autoplay carousel constitutes unprompted dynamic content shift without consent.

- ✅ **Instructions don't rely on memory of previous steps**
  - PASS — Each slide is self-contained with image, name, price, and badge.

#### Red Flags Check:

None of the auto-CRITICAL red flags apply directly here (no CAPTCHA/paste blocking/redundant entry). However, multiple MAJOR-level issues compound into a significant cognitive burden due to forced timing constraints and lack of control over content flow.

---

## Step 5 — Format findings

### Finding #1 – Missing `prefers-reduced-motion` Support Disables All Animations Under Reduced Motion Setting  
**WCAG:** [2.3.3 Prefer Reduced Motion](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/prefer-reduced-motion.html) *(AAA)* → Reported as ENHANCEMENT per severity rules  
**Perspective:** Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity  
**Severity:** ENHANCEMENT  
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)  
**Evidence:** `ProductCarousel.jsx` and `.carousel-wrapper` CSS contain no `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` guard around any animation or transition. Badge pulse (`@keyframes badgePulse`) and slide transitions remain active even when user requests reduced motion.  
**Fix:** Wrap all animations/transitions in a `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block that disables them entirely, leaving only static content visible.

---

### Finding #2 – No Pause/Stop Control for Autoplaying Carousel Violates User Agency Over Dynamic Content  
**WCAG:** [2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/pause-stop-hide.html) *(AA)*  
**Perspective:** Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity  
**Severity:** CRITICAL  
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)  
**Evidence:** `ProductCarousel.jsx` line 9–13 sets up an infinite `setInterval(() => setCurrentIndex(...), 3000)` with no associated pause/stop/hide button anywhere in markup or event handlers. Users cannot halt auto-rotation once mounted.  
**Fix:** Add a visible, keyboard-accessible play/pause toggle near the carousel controls that clears/resumes the interval timer upon activation.

---

### Finding #3 – Parallax Attribute Present Without Reduced-Motion Guard Risks Triggering Motion Sickness Triggers  
**WCAG:** [2.3.3 Prefer Reduced Motion](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/prefer-reduced-motion.html) *(AAA)* → Reported as ENHANCEMENT per severity rules  
**Perspective:** Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity  
**Severity:** ENHANCEMENT  
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)  
**Evidence:** `<div className="carousel-wrapper" data-parallax="true">` indicates planned parallax behavior. Even though not actively implemented in JS yet, it should be conditionally disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.  
**Fix:** Ensure any future parallax implementation respects `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` by disabling background attachment effects or replacing with flat visuals.

---

### Finding #4 – Auto-Advancing Carousel Causes Unexpected Content Shifts Without Warning or Consent  
**WCAG:** [3.2.1 On Focus](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/on-focus.html) *(AA)* and [2.2.1 Timing Adjustable](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/timing-adjustable.html) *(AA)*  
**Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent  
**Severity:** MAJOR  
**Route to:** UX Design (secondary: Front-End Dev)  
**Evidence:** `ProductCarousel.jsx` lines 9–13 initiate automatic slide rotation every 3 seconds regardless of user interaction state. There is no mechanism for users to delay, extend, or disable this timing constraint during engagement with the component. This violates expectations around predictable interfaces and adjustable timing.  
**Fix:** Implement a configurable timeout extension feature (e.g., show “Extend” prompt after X seconds), allow pausing via hover/focus, or provide explicit user control over auto-rotation speed/delay settings.

---

### Finding #5 – Continuous Auto-Rotation Disrupts Predictable Layout Expectations for Neurodivergent Users  
**WCAG:** [3.2.3 Consistent Navigation](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/consistent-navigation.html) *(AA)* and [3.2.4 Consistent Identification](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/consistent-identification.html) *(AA)*  
**Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent  
**Severity:** MAJOR  
**Route to:** UX Design (secondary: Front-End Dev)  
**Evidence:** The carousel continuously cycles through products every 3 seconds without stabilization, breaking spatial consistency and forcing users to reorient themselves repeatedly. This particularly impacts individuals with ADHD or autism who benefit from stable layouts.  
**Fix:** Allow users to freeze the current view manually using a dedicated “Pause” button, ensuring content remains stationary until they choose to resume navigation.

---

## Step 6 — Compile summary

## Perspective Audit Summary

**Component/artifact reviewed:** ProductCarousel React component (`ProductCarousel.jsx` + associated CSS)  
**Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity (HIGH), Cognitive & Neurodivergent (MEDIUM)  
**Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Auditory Access, Keyboard & Motor Access, Screen Reader & Semantic Structure

- Continuous Auto-Rotation Disrupts Predictable Layout Expectations for Neurodivergent Users — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — MAJOR — [WCAG 3.2.3](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/consistent-navigation.html), [WCAG 3.2.4](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/consistent-identification.html)
- Auto-Advancing Carousel Causes Unexpected Content Shifts Without Warning or Consent — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — MAJOR — [WCAG 3.2.1](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/on-focus.html), [WCAG 2.2.1](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/timing-adjustable.html)

### Open Questions Requiring Human Verification

No content-level findings requiring human verification were identified during this audit. All issues stem from technical implementation gaps rather than editorial or linguistic concerns.

### Recommended Next Step

**BLOCK** — One CRITICAL finding exists: the absence of a pause/stop control for an autoplaying carousel violates fundamental accessibility requirements and poses risks to users with vestibular disorders. This must be addressed before release. Additionally, two MAJOR findings related to cognitive load and timing adjustability should also be resolved prior to deployment.
